name: YEWLEE
recent: Yew Lee Pacific 近期多次因凭单转换为新股而发布额外上市公告，同时董事经理 Datuk Ang Lee Leong 在闭市期间申报了股份与凭单的权益变动及出售。公司也进行了股份回购。
notable: 凭单转换为新股，涉及多批新股上市。
董事经理 Datuk Ang Lee Leong 在闭市期间出售股份及凭单。
risks: 董事经理在闭市期间出售股份及凭单。
凭单持续转换可能增加流通股数量。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为 MYR 4,805,000，环比增长1.3%，同比增长5.8%；净利为 MYR 527,000，环比下降62.7%，净利率从上一季度的29.8%降至11.0%。

recent_en: Yew Lee Pacific has made multiple additional listing announcements due to warrant conversions into new shares, while Managing Director Datuk Ang Lee Leong reported changes in his share and warrant interests and disposals during the closed period.
notable_en: Conversion of warrants into new ordinary shares, with several batches of new shares listed.
Managing Director Datuk Ang Lee Leong disposed of shares and warrants during the closed period.
risks_en: The Managing Director disposed of shares and warrants during the closed period.
Continued warrant conversions may increase the number of shares in circulation.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 4,805,000, up 1.3% QoQ and 5.8% YoY; net income was MYR 527,000, down 62.7% QoQ, with net margin falling to 11.0% from 29.8% in the previous quarter.
